title: ZeroRAG: Adaptive Semantic Peer Routing for Decentralized Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.07928v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a standard approach to enhance the reliability of large language model (LLM) outputs by retrieving documents relevant to a query and supplying them in the LLM prompt. Today's RAG systems collect, index, and serve these documents from centralized stores. In practice, however, documents are owned by organizations, devices, and individuals who cannot or will not surrender custody of them to a central party, e.g., because of privacy, copyright or regulatory compliance. Existing modern decentralized retrieval techniques either reintroduce a coordinating authority, or rely on a global data structure that requires continuous network-wide coordination (e.g., DHTs). We present ZeroRAG, a decentralized routing layer for document retrieval in RAG that performs semantic query routing across an overlay of peers with- out global data structures or centralized orchestration. translated_title: ZeroRAG：面向去中心化检索增强生成的自适应语义对等路由
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）是一种通过检索与查询相关的文档并将其注入大语言模型（LLM）提示中来提升LLM输出可靠性的标准方法。如今的RAG系统从集中式存储中收集、索引并提供这些文档。然而在实践中，文档的所有者是组织、设备和个人，由于隐私、版权或监管合规等原因，他们不能或不愿将文档的托管权移交给中央机构。现有的现代去中心化检索技术要么重新引入协调机构，要么依赖需要全网持续协调的全局数据结构（如分布式哈希表DHT）。我们提出了ZeroRAG，这是一个面向RAG文档检索的去中心化路由层，它在由对等节点构成的覆盖网络上执行语义查询路由，无需全局数据结构或集中式编排。文档仍保留在其所属的对等节点上。（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: ZeroRAG提出了一种无需全局数据结构和集中式编排的去中心化RAG文档检索方案，通过在对等覆盖网络上进行自适应语义查询路由，使文档始终保留在原始所有者手中。
en_tdlr: ZeroRAG presents a decentralized routing layer for RAG document retrieval that performs adaptive semantic query routing across a peer overlay without global data structures or centralized orchestration, keeping documents in the custody of their original owners.
